events.title: **Remake17** is set to participate in Steam Next Fest, October 2026 Edition
events.summary: **Remake17** is set to participate in Steam Next Fest, October 2026 Edition *Remake17* is the second Galgame developed by Entropy Link Tianchaung. In this game, you take on the role of Liang Yu, a high school student. After a car accident, you travel back to the past, where you meet and reconnect with three female classmates — Ye Yunqing, Hua Lin, and Chen Shiran.
